videos.caption: I am very sad to announce that our beloved PP “Gudzilly”, has passed away on October 12th 2026.  PP was a Orange Tabby cat rescued from a tree in 2012 and was spoiled ever since. He was by far, the Bestest of Goodest Boys ever, even though he hated me.  Pumpkin only loved his mommy❤️ Goodbye little friend.
